inspiration.observed_pattern: The public regression SQL exercises EXCEPT ALL set-operation syntax and INSERT ... RETURNING write results.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Combine those constructs in an independently authored MariaDB fixture: subtract the observed label multiset from a baseline label multiset with EXCEPT ALL, insert the remaining occurrences in deterministic order, and return generated archive IDs.

fixture_notes: The baseline stream contains alpha three times, beta twice, and gamma once; the observed stream consumes one alpha and one beta. EXCEPT ALL retains alpha twice, beta once, and gamma once.
determinism_notes: All source labels and duplicate counts are fixed; the derived multiset is ordered by label before insertion, and returned/final rows are ordered by archive ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE baseline_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE observed_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE excess_label_archive (archive_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, label_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO excess_label_archive (label_name) SELECT excess.label_name FROM (SELECT label_name FROM baseline_labels EXCEPT ALL SELECT label_name FROM observed_labels) AS excess ORDER BY excess.label_name RETURNING archive_id, label_name
SELECT archive_id, label_name FROM excess_label_archive ORDER BY archive_id
